// INBUF module
module origen_125198 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire enq,
    input wire [31:0] din,
    output reg full,
    output reg [31:0] dout
);
    reg [31:0] buffer;
    reg valid;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            buffer <= 32'b0;
            valid <= 1'b0;
            full <= 1'b0;
        end else if (enq && !full) begin
            buffer <= din;
            valid <= 1'b1;
            full <= 1'b1;
        end
    end

    always @(*) begin
        dout = valid ? buffer : 32'b0;
    end
endmodule

// MRE2 module
module MRE2 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire enq,
    input wire deq,
    input wire [31:0] din,
    output reg [31:0] dot,
    output reg emp,
    output reg full,
    output reg [1:0] cnt
);
    reg [31:0] buffer [0:1];
    reg [1:0] head, tail;

    always @(posedge clk or posedge rst) begin
        if (rst) begin
            head <= 2'b0;
            tail <= 2'b0;
            emp <= 1'b1;
            full <= 1'b0;
            cnt <= 2'b0;
        end else begin
            if (enq && !full) begin
                buffer[tail] <= din;
                tail <= tail + 1;
                cnt <= cnt + 1;
                emp <= 1'b0;
                full <= (cnt == 1);
            end
            if (deq && !emp) begin
                head <= head + 1;
                cnt <= cnt - 1;
                full <= 1'b0;
                emp <= (cnt == 1);
            end
        end
    end

    always @(*) begin
        dot = buffer[head];
    end
endmodule

// SCELL module
module SCELL (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst,
    input wire emp1,
    input wire emp2,
    input wire deq1,
    input wire deq2,
    input wire [31:0] dot1,
    input wire [31:0] dot2,
    input wire full,
    input wire [31:0] din,
    input wire enq,
    output reg [31:0] dout,
    output reg deq_out1,
    output reg deq_out2,
    output reg enq_out
);
    reg [31:0] min_value;

    always @(*) begin
        if (emp1 && emp2) begin
            min_value = 32'hFFFFFFFF;
            deq_out1 = 1'b0;
            deq_out2 = 1'b0;
        end else if (emp1) begin
            min_value = dot2;
            deq_out1 = 1'b0;
            deq_out2 = 1'b1;
        end else if (emp2) begin
            min_value = dot1;
            deq_out1 = 1'b1;
            deq_out2 = 1'b0;
        end else begin
            if (dot1 <= dot2) begin
                min_value = dot1;
                deq_out1 = 1'b1;
                deq_out2 = 1'b0;
            end else begin
                min_value = dot2;
                deq_out1 = 1'b0;
                deq_out2 = 1'b1;
            end
        end

        dout = min_value;
        enq_out = !full && (deq1 || deq2);
    end
endmodule
